author: yummys
body:
IGN: withouts
Discord(ex. Name#1234): withouts#3902
Timezone: Mountain Daylight Time
Why would you like to join the referee team(brief paragraph): I would like to join the referee team so I can ref matches, so people can have a fun time and enjoy the matches, instead of complaining how it wasn't fair, or how the other team cheated, I want to be ref to make sure people have fair fun matches.
Best time of the week?: Monday-Saturday after 12 MDT
A paragraph or two to tell us something about yourself(Pretend you are trying to sell yourself to us): Okay, so my name is Aaron I am 15 years old, I enjoy playing with other people and spending time with the avicus community, both public and competitive. I enjoy pvping and mini moding. Yes I am trying to become a mod, but I would love to become a referee to at least help out the community as much as I can.
Anything else?: I really want to become referee to do my part for this community, after all they bring me joy and fun, so I am just trying to give back.
